Method of Attack: The package contains obfuscation mechanisms to thwart analysis. It enumerates the user's environment and sends it to a remote actor. It also includes a preinstall hook that executes a malicious Javascript file.
Impacted Systems: Bucky Client project owned by HubSpot
Any system where the package is installed
Attack Vector: Malware is injected through the installation of the npm package. It then collects environment variables and sends them to a remote server.
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of ca-bucky-client in npm packages
Enumeration and transmission of environment variables
